How much does it cost to run a heated clothes airer?

A typical heated clothes airer uses about 300 watts (200–400W depending on the model). Used for 6 hours per use, 3 uses a week, for 6 months of the year, it costs about 47p per use and £36.95 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
47p
About £36.95 a year at 6 hours per use, 3 uses a week, 6 months a year.

Standing charge not included.

About these figures

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Wash at 30°C and run full loads.
  • Spin at the highest speed the fabric allows before drying.
  • Dry outside or on an airer when you can; heat is the expensive part.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a heated clothes airer per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 300W model costs about 7.9p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run a heated clothes airer per year?

About £36.95 a year, based on 6 hours per use, 3 uses a week, 6 months a year. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my heated clothes airer's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
